import json
from pathlib import Path

REPORT = {'exact_subject': True, 'files_staged': True, 'secret_excluded': True, 'single_commit': True}

import subprocess


def git(*args):
    proc = subprocess.run(['git'] + list(args), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
